entries.en: Added `--marketplace <source>` to `claude plugin install`: adds the marketplace if needed, under the same policy checks as `claude plugin marketplace add`, then installs the plugin from it
entries.zh: 在“claude插件安装”中添加了`--marketplace <source>`：如果需要，在与“claude插件市场添加”相同的策略检查下添加市场，然后从中安装插件

entries.en: Added an `effort` parameter to the Agent tool, so Claude runs a sub-agent at the effort level you ask for
entries.zh: 在代理工具中添加了`effort`参数，因此 Claude 按照您要求的工作量运行子代理

entries.en: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer base delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request
entries.zh: 添加了`CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS`环境变量，以便在重试过载 (529) 请求时为退避设置更长的基本延迟

entries.en: Added `prompt.autocomplete`, an event a mod hooks to add its own rows to the prompt box's autocomplete list
entries.zh: 添加了`prompt.autocomplete`，这是 mod 挂钩的一个事件，用于将自己的行添加到提示框的自动完成列表中

entries.en: Added prompt caching to `$.model.complete` for mods: `prompt` and `system` take blocks of text, and `cache: true` on a block caches the request up to it
entries.zh: 为模组的`$.model.complete`添加了提示缓存：`prompt`和`system`采用文本块，块上的`cache: true`将请求缓存到该块

entries.en: Added workflow agents to the `agent.spawn` mod hook, with their run and index, so a mod can refuse them
entries.zh: 将工作流代理添加到`agent.spawn` mod hook，及其运行和索引，以便 mod 可以拒绝它们

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Added an Edit button to the Allowed domains card on a channel's Configure page, so Enterprise admins can open the access bundle that sets the channel's domains
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 频道配置页面的「Allowed domains」卡片新增「Edit」按钮，企业版管理员可直接打开设置该频道域名的访问包

entries.en: [Code Review] Added the period's total with its change from the previous period, and a breakdown by repository, to the PRs reviewed chart in Code Review analytics
entries.zh: [Code Review] Code Review 分析中的「PRs reviewed」图表新增本期总数及与上期的变化，并新增按仓库的细分

entries.en: Improved startup of `claude -p` and SDK sessions: the first turn no longer waits for HTTP and SSE MCP servers to answer `resources/list`
entries.zh: 改进 `claude -p` 和 SDK 会话的启动：第一轮对话不再等待 HTTP 和 SSE 类 MCP 服务器响应 `resources/list`

entries.en: Improved rendering speed of long bulleted or numbered replies: they stream, resize and re-open in the transcript (ctrl+o) much faster
entries.zh: 改进长篇项目符号或编号列表回复的渲染速度：流式输出、调整大小以及用 ctrl+o 重新打开转录时都更快

entries.en: Improved Ctrl+C draft recovery: a cleared prompt now stays reachable with Up after a slash command or a sent message
entries.zh: 改进 Ctrl+C 草稿恢复：被清空的提示词在发送斜杠命令或消息后，仍可以按上方向键找回

entries.en: Improved hook output handling: `<system-reminder>` tags written in a hook's output are escaped before they reach Claude
entries.zh: 改进 hook 输出处理：hook 输出中写的 `<system-reminder>` 标签在送给 Claude 前会被转义

entries.en: Improved tool input handling: Grep accepts `file_path` for `path`, and Write, WebFetch and Read ignore a few stray parameters instead of failing the call
entries.zh: 改进工具输入处理：Grep 接受 `file_path` 代替 `path`；Write、WebFetch 和 Read 会忽略几个多余的参数，而不是直接报错

entries.en: Improved the steps shown when a marketplace declared in a settings file has a name that looks like an official Anthropic marketplace
entries.zh: 改进：设置文件中声明的市场如果名称看起来像 Anthropic 官方市场，会显示相应的提示步骤

entries.en: Improved sandbox auto-allow: with strict sandbox mode set in user, managed or --settings settings, an interpreter command with an env var prefix like `FOO=bar python3 app.py` runs unprompted
entries.zh: 改进沙盒自动放行：在用户、托管或 `--settings` 设置中启用严格沙盒模式后，带环境变量前缀的解释器命令（如 `FOO=bar python3 app.py`）无需提示即可运行

entries.en: Improved the Artifact tool's listing: Claude now sees how many published artifacts you have and can list up to 200 at once instead of 50
entries.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具的列表：Claude 能看到你已发布的 Artifact 数量，并且一次最多可列出 200 个（以前是 50 个）

entries.en: Improved cloud sessions after a restart: Claude is now told which stopped background agents it can resume by id
entries.zh: 改进云会话重启后的情况：Claude 会被告知哪些已停止的后台 agent 可以按 id 恢复

entries.en: Improved the Claude in Chrome message in claude.ai cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: Claude is now told it may continue with alternatives if the user prefers
entries.zh: 改进 claude.ai 云端会话中「无法连接 Chrome 浏览器」的提示：如果用户希望，Claude 现在会被告知可以改用其他方案继续

entries.en: Improved the /focus tip: it now invites you to try focus view mid-turn and shows how to switch back
entries.zh: 改进 /focus 提示：现在会邀请你在回合进行中尝试专注视图，并说明如何切换回来

entries.en: Improved startup with local (stdio) MCP servers that ignore the newer protocol check: after one slow connect they are remembered for 7 days and connected the older way without the wait
entries.zh: 改进启动：忽略较新协议检查的本地（stdio）MCP 服务器，若首次连接较慢，之后 7 天内会记住该结果，并以旧方式直接连接，不再等待

entries.en: Changed local (stdio) MCP server connections to negotiate protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on every install, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
entries.zh: 更改了本地 (stdio) MCP 服务器连接，以在每次安装时默认协商协议版本 2026-07-28，包括 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry； `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` 选择退出

entries.en: Changed `claude plugin test`: a failed `expect` inside a hook the test registered, or a stub answer the engine refuses, now fails the test instead of passing silently
entries.zh: 更改了“claude插件测试”：测试注册的钩子内失败的`expect`，或者引擎拒绝的存根答案，现在使测试失败，而不是默默地通过

entries.en: Changed usage limit messages to write claude.ai settings links with https:// so terminals and apps can make them clickable
entries.zh: 更改了使用限制消息，以使用 https:// 编写 claude.ai 设置链接，以便终端和应用程序可以使它们可点击

entries.en: Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs to publish a new artifact only you can see without asking for approval; artifacts that request connectors or other access still ask
entries.zh: 更改了计划和立即运行例行运行，以发布只有您可以看到的新工件，而无需请求批准；请求连接器或其他访问的工件仍然会询问

entries.en: Changed agent names to allow at most 256 characters: a longer one is rejected, and a skill's or a plugin file's `name` longer than that is ignored
entries.zh: 更改了代理名称以允许最多 256 个字符：较长的字符将被拒绝，并且技能或插件文件的“名称”长于此的将被忽略

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Improved `@Claude !status` in a channel to say when Claude has stopped reading its untagged messages, why, and that an @-mention starts it reading again
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 改进频道中的 `@Claude !status`：会说明 Claude 何时停止读取未 @ 的消息、原因为何，以及 @ 提及会让它重新开始读取

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the first message of a Slack thread continued with `!fork` to a card showing where it came from, the request, and who asked, with a link to the original thread
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 用 `!fork` 延续的 Slack 话题，其第一条消息改为卡片显示：来源、请求内容、提问人，并附原话题链接

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Changed the organization-wide and default spend limit boxes on Claude Tag's spend limits page in admin settings to save only when you press Save or Enter, not when you click away
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 管理设置花费限额页面中，组织范围和默认花费限额输入框改为只在按 Save 或 Enter 时保存，点击别处不再保存

entries.en: Fixed subagent definitions with `permissionMode: auto` entering auto mode when auto mode is unavailable (disabled by settings, circuit breaker, or a model that doesn't support it)
entries.zh: 修复了当自动模式不可用时`permissionMode: auto`进入自动模式的子代理定义（被设置、断路器或不支持它的模型禁用）

entries.en: Fixed sandboxed commands being able to read the staged file copies of `/ultrareview` uploads under `~/.claude/seed-admin`
entries.zh: 修复了沙盒命令能够读取`~/.claude/seed-admin`下上传的`/ultrareview`的暂存文件副本的问题

entries.en: Fixed a managed sandbox read-deny path (and user ones beside it) that appears or re-points mid-session not dropping project grants inside it or ending credential injection from files it covers
entries.zh: 修复了在会话中出现或重新指向的托管沙箱读取拒绝路径（及其旁边的用户路径），该路径不会将项目授权放入其中或结束从其覆盖的文件中的凭据注入

entries.en: Fixed a notebook or PDF read on macOS and Windows being able to return a file outside what was approved, through a link swapped in mid-read
entries.zh: 修复了在 macOS 和 Windows 上读取的笔记本或 PDF 能够通过在读取过程中交换的链接返回超出批准范围的文件

entries.en: Fixed a tampered on-disk cache of server-managed settings being able to switch off or unseat the built-in policy plugin while the settings fetch failed
entries.zh: 修复了服务器管理设置的磁盘缓存被篡改的问题，在设置获取失败时能够关闭或取消内置策略插件

entries.en: Fixed `rm -rf` on the 8.3 short name or another alternate Windows spelling of the home folder or a drive not being treated as removing it
entries.zh: 修复了 8.3 短名称上的`rm -rf`或主文件夹的其他替代 Windows 拼写或驱动器不被视为删除它

entries.en: Security: Fixed PreToolUse hook approvals and auto mode bypassing the permission prompt for file reads from network (UNC) paths
entries.zh: 安全：修复 PreToolUse 钩子的批准和自动模式绕过权限提示、读取网络（UNC）路径文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed a skill's or slash command's `allowed-tools` rule coming back in a later turn when you leave auto mode or plan mode partway through that turn
entries.zh: 修复了当您在该回合中途离开自动模式或计划模式时，技能或斜杠命令的“允许工具”规则会在稍后的回合中返回

entries.en: Fixed `NO_PROXY` being ignored for Claude Code's own API requests (sign-in, policy, feedback, artifacts) when `HTTPS_PROXY` is set
entries.zh: 修复了设置`HTTPS_PROXY`时 Claude Code 自己的 API 请求（登录、策略、反馈、工件）忽略`NO_PROXY`的问题

entries.en: Fixed an MCP tool with a name longer than 128 characters making every request fail; that tool is now left out and an MCP error names it
entries.zh: 修复了名称超过 128 个字符的 MCP 工具导致每次请求失败的问题；该工具现在已被排除，并且 MCP 错误将其命名

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin` commands such as `marketplace add` and `install` running before an organization's managed settings had loaded on a first run
entries.zh: 修复了在首次运行时加载组织的托管设置之前运行的`claude plugin`命令，例如`marketplace add`和`install`

entries.en: Fixed one-shot `claude -p` and Agent SDK runs stopping a background command 5 seconds after the final result, and one-shot `claude -p` runs dropping a scheduled wakeup; both are now waited for
entries.zh: 修复了一次性`claude -p`和 Agent SDK 在最终结果后 5 秒运行停止后台命令，以及一次性`claude -p`运行丢弃计划唤醒的问题；两者现在都在等待

entries.en: Fixed plan mode not being restored when resuming a session from the `claude --resume` session picker or with `/resume`
entries.zh: 修复了从`claude --resume`会话选择器或使用`/resume`恢复会话时计划模式未恢复的问题

entries.en: Fixed saved scheduled tasks created after `/resume`, `/branch` or `/clear` never firing, and saved tasks ignoring later creates and deletes after two writes to the tasks file milliseconds apart
entries.zh: 修复了在`/resume`、`/branch`或`/clear`之后创建的保存的计划任务永远不会触发，以及保存的任务在两次写入任务文件后忽略稍后创建和删除的问题

entries.en: Fixed a background session's `/loop` silently stopping when the session's process restarted (for example after a crash), because its pending wakeup was lost
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话的`/loop`在会话进程重新启动时（例如崩溃后）静默停止，因为其挂起的唤醒丢失了

entries.en: Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the file or folder they were given could not be read; Claude now retries once or tells you
entries.zh: 修复了当无法读取给定的文件或文件夹时 Grep 和 Glob 报告不匹配的问题；克劳德现在重试一次或者告诉你

entries.en: Fixed the Read tool returning only the first entry, with no error, when a PDF's `pages` was a list such as "6,9,15"; it now returns an error saying to read each page or range separately
entries.zh: 修复 PDF 的 `pages` 为 "6,9,15" 这类列表时，Read 工具只返回第一项且不报错的问题；现在会提示分别读取每一页或每个范围

entries.en: Fixed @-mentioned text files over 256KB being left out silently: Claude is now told the file's size and to read it in portions
entries.zh: 修复了@提到的超过 256KB 的文本文件被默默忽略的问题：克劳德现在被告知文件的大小并分部分读取它

entries.en: Fixed the usage limit alert repeating once per background agent when agents failed on a limit that had already stopped the main conversation
entries.zh: 修复智能体因已停止主对话的同一用量上限而失败时，用量上限提醒会按后台智能体逐个重复出现的问题

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control viewers seeing an empty subagent pane for background subagents in sessions hosted by the desktop app or an IDE
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制查看器在桌面应用程序或 IDE 托管的会话中看到后台子代理的空子代理窗格的问题

entries.en: Fixed cross-session delivery notices showing two sessions with similar names as one recipient, and the expiry notice blaming the desktop app when a terminal session let the message lapse
entries.zh: 修复了跨会话传送通知，显示两个会话与一个收件人具有相似的名称，并且当终端会话让消息失效时，到期通知会指责桌面应用程序

entries.en: Fixed Send now in the desktop app ending the subagent a turn was waiting on when another message was already queued
entries.zh: 修复了当另一条消息已排队时，在桌面应用程序中立即发送以结束子代理轮次等待的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/bug`, `/share` and `/feedback <text>` starting over after Ctrl+O or Ctrl+Z while a report was being sent, and closing as cancelled after it had been sent
entries.zh: 修复了`/bug`、`/share`和`/feedback <text>`在发送报告时按 Ctrl+O 或 Ctrl+Z 后重新开始，并在发送后关闭为已取消的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/remote-env` replacing your saved default environment when you pressed Enter right away: the list now opens on your default, and no row has a check mark when no default is in effect
entries.zh: 修复了当您立即按下 Enter 时`/remote-env`替换您保存的默认环境的问题：列表现在以您的默认值打开，并且当没有默认值生效时，没有行有复选标记

entries.en: Fixed some pasted text reaching Claude as typed text when several pastes overlapped in one prompt
entries.zh: 修复了当多个粘贴在一个提示中重叠时，一些粘贴的文本作为键入的文本到达克劳德的问题

entries.en: Fixed vim mode leaving the cursor past the end of a line, j/k losing their column on shorter lines, and `f`/`t`/`F`/`T`/`;`/`,` jumping to, or deleting up to, a match on another line of the prompt
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式下光标越过行尾、j/k 在较短行上丢失列位置，以及 `f`/`t`/`F`/`T`/`;`/`,` 跳转到或删除到提示框其他行中匹配项的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/add-dir` path box letting Shift+Enter or a paste add a line break, and treating fast-typed "tab", "up" or "down" as those keys
entries.zh: 修复了`/add-dir`路径框，让 Shift+Enter 或粘贴添加换行符，并将快速键入的“tab”、“up”或“down”视为这些键

entries.en: Fixed fast typing, input-method text and decomposed accents being dropped while a prompt footer row was selected, and `!` leaving the row selected
entries.zh: 修复了选择提示页脚行时删除快速打字、输入法文本和分解重音以及`!`使该行保持选中状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen mode sending a full-screen clear on every window resize and Ctrl+L when iTerm2 is detected, which may be what filled iTerm2's scrollback with stale pages
entries.zh: 修复了全屏模式在检测到 iTerm2 时在每个窗口大小调整和 Ctrl+L 上发送全屏清除，这可能是 iTerm2 的回滚中充满陈旧页面的原因

entries.en: Fixed a spurious "could not be examined" note for @-words that name no file when a Read deny rule is set and the working directory is under a symlink
entries.zh: 修复了 @-words 的虚假“无法检查”注释，当设置读取拒绝规则并且工作目录位于符号链接下时，该注释不会命名任何文件

entries.en: Fixed "instruction file not loaded" lines going stale or missing after `/cd` or a permission change, and added a transcript line when a nested one isn't loaded
entries.zh: 修复了`/cd`或权限更改后“指令文件未加载”行过时或丢失的问题，并在未加载嵌套行时添加了转录行

entries.en: Fixed a compaction summary that repeated `/name` letting Claude invoke a skill that is reserved for the user
entries.zh: 修复了重复`/name`的压缩摘要，让克劳德调用为用户保留的技能

entries.en: Fixed Write, Edit, NotebookEdit and LSP rows, and single Read, Grep and Glob rows, hiding why a mod denied the call: the row now shows the reason
entries.zh: 修复了 Write、Edit、NotebookEdit 和 LSP 行以及单个 Read、Grep 和 Glob 行，隐藏了 mod 拒绝调用的原因：该行现在显示原因

entries.en: Fixed a cloud session showing a turn that never ended when its worker was stopped just as the turn finished
entries.zh: 修复了一个云会话，显示当其工作人员在回合结束时停止时，回合从未结束

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions with a large transcript sometimes asking for a permission again after it was approved
entries.zh: 修复了具有大记录的云会话有时在获得批准后再次请求许可的问题

entries.en: Fixed scheduled tasks and other queued notifications being lost in cloud sessions when a message was retried or edited while Claude was reading them
entries.zh: 修复了当克劳德阅读消息时重试或编辑消息时，计划任务和其他排队通知在云会话中丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed cloud sessions forgetting the thinking setting chosen in the client when the session's container restarted
entries.zh: 修复了云会话在会话容器重新启动时忘记在客户端中选择的思考设置的问题

entries.en: Fixed Cowork cloud sessions saying a proxy blocked artifacts when Anthropic couldn't confirm the organization's settings
entries.zh: 修复了当 Anthropic 无法确认组织设置时 Cowork 云会话显示代理阻止工件的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugins whose hooks module makes many `$.state` calls through one const taking minutes to load or validate
entries.zh: 修复了其 hooks 模块通过一个 const 进行许多`$.state`调用，需要几分钟来加载或验证的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a matcher or state value for a hooks module that the engine reads from elsewhere
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`，列出了引擎从其他地方读取的钩子模块的匹配器或状态值

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin validate` listing a `$.state` value read through a top-level `var` that was declared again or reassigned; such a module is now refused
entries.zh: 修复了`claude plugin validate`，列出了通过再次声明或重新分配的顶级`var`读取的`$.state`值；这样的模块现在被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's served `$` method restarting the hook origin, which could run a guard hook with a `.catch` above it again without end
entries.zh: 修复了插件的服务`$`方法重新启动钩子原点，该方法可以再次运行上面有`.catch`的防护钩子而没有结束

entries.en: Fixed plugin interface calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts running without the hooks other plugins put on them
entries.zh: 修复了插件钩子工作程序重新启动运行时进行的插件接口调用，而没有其他插件添加的钩子

entries.en: Fixed a mod's `config.set`, `state.set`, `env.set` or `agent.spawn` hook that denies after calling `next(e)` being answered as a refusal: the hook is now reported as failed, by name
entries.zh: 修复了 mod 的 `config.set`、`state.set`、`env.set` 或 `agent.spawn` 钩子，该钩子在调用 `next(e)` 后被拒绝回答：该钩子现在按名称报告为失败

entries.en: Fixed `/theme`, the `/config` Theme menu and the first-run theme step saving a theme before a plugin's `config.set` hook was asked
entries.zh: 修复了`/theme`、`/config`主题菜单和首次运行主题步骤在询问插件的`config.set`挂钩之前保存主题的问题

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's `tool.check` hook answering allow running a tool that requires your answer (a question, a plan approval) without showing its dialog
entries.zh: 修复插件的 `tool.check` 钩子在需要你回答的工具（如提问、计划审批）上直接放行运行、没有弹出对话框的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's start-up prompt, command or subagent being queued a second time when the hooks worker was replaced
entries.zh: 修复了更换 hooks 工作线程后，mod 的启动提示、命令或子代理再次排队的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's hook that called `next(e)` and then failed while the turn was interrupted letting the call through; the call is now rejected
entries.zh: 修复了一个 mod 的钩子，该钩子调用了`next(e)`，然后在回合被中断以让调用通过时失败；呼叫现已被拒绝

entries.en: Fixed a plugin's prompt drop or setting deny being ignored when its reason was longer than 4,096 characters
entries.zh: 修复了插件的提示删除或设置拒绝在其原因超过 4,096 个字符时被忽略的问题

entries.en: Fixed an organization's plugin being unloaded on its own reload, or after another plugin crashed, when it returned a `$` name that a user-installed mod had added; the mod is now unloaded instead
entries.zh: 修复了组织的插件在其自身重新加载时或在另一个插件崩溃后返回用户安装的 mod 添加的`$`名称时被卸载的问题；该模组现在已被卸载

entries.en: Fixed tool calls made while the plugin hooks worker restarts being answered without the plugins' permission hooks
entries.zh: 修复插件钩子工作进程重启期间发出的工具调用，被回复时缺少插件权限钩子的问题

entries.en: Fixed plugin `tool.call` hooks seeing some tool calls before misnamed parameters were repaired; a hook now sees the arguments the tool will run with
entries.zh: 修复了插件`tool.call`挂钩在修复错误命名的参数之前看到一些工具调用的问题；钩子现在可以看到该工具运行时使用的参数

entries.en: Fixed a mod's guard hook with a `.catch` being skipped silently for calls another mod's hook makes beneath the guard's own `$` call; its `.catch` is now asked
entries.zh: 修复了一个 mod 的防护钩子，当另一个 mod 的钩子在防护器自己的`$`调用之下进行调用时，会默默地跳过`.catch`；现在询问它的`.catch`

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs occasionally staying listed as running for hours after they had finished
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复例程运行结束后，偶尔仍显示为运行中长达数小时的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed editing or duplicating a routine turning off its push notifications when the routine had no saved notification setting
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复例程没有已保存的通知设置时，编辑或复制例程会关闭其推送通知的问题

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed SVG, HEIC, TIFF and other less common image files failing to attach; they now attach as regular files
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复 SVG、HEIC、TIFF 等较少见的图片文件无法附加的问题；现在会作为普通文件附加

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed approval prompts offering "Always allow" for connector tools that an organization set to require approval; the choice had no effect
entries.zh: [Cloud sessions] 修复组织要求连接器工具必须批准时，批准提示仍提供「Always allow」选项、且该选择无效的问题

entries.en: [Remote Control] Fixed the first message of a new Remote Control session started from claude.ai/code accepting only images; it now accepts PDFs and other files like later messages
entries.zh: [Remote Control] 修复从 claude.ai/code 发起的新 Remote Control 会话，其第一条消息只接受图片的问题；现在和后续消息一样，可以接受 PDF 和其他文件

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed replies sent in a Slack thread while Claude was still on its first request there being held until that request finished, or missed when sent seconds apart
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复 Claude 仍在处理话题的第一个请求时，在该话题中发送的回复会被延迟到请求结束才处理，或在相隔几秒发送时被漏掉的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack threads woken only by GitHub pull request activity or a routine staying on their original model after an admin changed the channel or workspace default model
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复仅由 GitHub 拉取请求活动或例程唤醒的 Slack 话题，在管理员修改频道或工作区默认模型后，仍停留在原模型的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes posting a spend limit notice in Slack when the real cause was that your organization had run out of usage credits
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复实际原因是组织用尽用量额度，但 Claude 有时却在 Slack 中发出花费限额通知的问题

entries.en: [Claude Tag] Fixed a session hanging until interrupted when a permission prompt that can't be answered from Slack was denied automatically
entries.zh: [Claude Tag] 修复无法在 Slack 中回答的权限提示被自动拒绝后，会话挂起直到被中断的问题

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed a queued review failing when the pull request moved to a new base branch and the old one was deleted; the commit is now re-queued for review
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复拉取请求切换到新的基础分支、而旧分支被删除时，排队中的审查失败的问题；现在该提交会重新排队审查

entries.en: [Code Review] Fixed reviews ignoring a CLAUDE.md's rules when the pull request edits that file; reviews now use its version from the base branch
entries.zh: [Code Review] 修复拉取请求修改了 CLAUDE.md 时，审查忽略其中规则的问题；现在审查会使用基础分支中的版本
